newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes firmer.

text.p: White sugar futures continued to move higher in late afternoon business on Monday in a steady volume of business.
A similar trend in New York helped London extend its earlier advance and by the close August was trading at $327.90 a tonne, up $3.80 and total turnover was 3,445 lots.
Trade players were the dominant force behind the day's activity, although commission house were more active earlier in the session, traders said.
"It's been been trade-dominated...but there is scale-up selling the whole way," said one.
"There is a lot of selling around in London from here on up -- and the same in New York," he said.
Traders said Brazilian producer pricing on the raws had capped gains in New York in a band between 11.20 and 11.30 cents/lb basis July, leading to a dampening of sentiment in London.
Brazilian pricing was also being seen on October, they said.
August Paris ended at $325.50 a tonne, up $1.6.
